summary: Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, or WooCommerce? Compare the best ecommerce platforms for selling custom products in 2026.

## Best Ecommerce Platforms for Custom Products


When diving into the world of e-commerce, the abundance of software options can feel overwhelming. They all promise to help you build a killer website, expand your marketing efforts, and streamline your operations. But which features should you prioritize?


Here are some key considerations:


🔒 **Security:** With sensitive customer data and payment transactions at stake, robust security measures are non-negotiable. Look for software that prioritizes data protection to safeguard your customers' trust and your business's reputation.


⚡ **Performance:** Nobody likes a slow-loading website, especially when they're ready to make a purchase. Opt for a platform that offers swift performance, ensuring smooth navigation for your customers and reducing the risk of abandoned shopping carts.


**📦 Order Management:** Efficient order processing is essential for customer satisfaction. Seek out software with intuitive order management tools that automate processes and keep customers informed at every stage, from order placement to delivery.


**📈 Marketing Tools:** Marketing is key to driving sales and growing your brand. Choose software equipped with robust marketing features that enable you to create, track, and optimize campaigns across various channels to reach your target audience effectively.


🔄 **Integrations:** Your e-commerce software should seamlessly integrate with other tools and software you rely on. Prioritize platforms that offer a wide range of integrations, allowing you to connect with your preferred apps and streamline your workflow.


**📊 Data and Analytics:** To make informed decisions and refine your strategies, access to comprehensive data and analytics is crucial. Look for software that provides insights into your website performance, social media presence, and overall marketing efforts.


By focusing on these key features, you can choose e-commerce software that not only meets your current needs but also sets you up for success as your business grows 💪.


## How to Choose the Best Platform for Selling Custom Products


Choosing the best ecommerce platform for custom products can feel overwhelming. Each solution promises growth, flexibility, and ease of use, but not all platforms are equally suited for selling personalized or print-on-demand products.


If you want full control over branding and personalization, standalone ecommerce platforms are often the best choice. Marketplaces, on the other hand, can help you validate demand quickly thanks to built-in traffic, but may limit customization and long-term flexibility.

Whether you're just starting out or you've been in the game for a while, Shopify is perfect for businesses of all sizes. Seriously, it's like the Swiss Army knife of e-commerce platforms 🪒. And with their awesome customer service, you'll always have someone there to help you out.

## ‍ **Etsy**


Ever heard of[Etsy](https://www.customily.com/etsy) ? It's like a bustling online marketplace where nearly[7 million stores](https://www.marketplacepulse.com/stats/etsy-number-of-active-sellers) are selling all sorts of cool stuff – think handmade items, art, collectibles, and even custom products. 🛍️


**Features**


What makes Etsy stand out? Well, for starters, it's super easy to use and has a huge community of active buyers (like[96.2 million](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/etsy-statistics/) active buyers huge!) 🌟. This means more eyeballs on your products and a better chance of making sales. Plus, Etsy offers handy tools to help you market your business, like pop-up storefronts and promotional features.


**Pricing**


When you sell on Etsy, you pay a listing fee of $0.20 for each item you put up for sale. Your listing stays active for four months or until you make your first sale, whichever comes first. Once you do make a sale, Etsy takes a cut – 6.5% of the item's price, plus a payment processing fee of at least 2.6% plus $0.10. 💸


And if you're selling from Canada or the US, Etsy applies the transaction fees to the listed price, excluding sales tax. Plus, if you charge separate shipping fees, Etsy takes a slice of that too – 5% of the total shipping charges.


**Who's it for?**


Etsy is great for beginners thanks to its user-friendly setup and massive buyer base. And if you're looking to level up your Etsy game, they've got an Etsy Plus plan with extra tools and customization options to help you grow.


Just remember to factor in all the fees before you dive in. Some merchants find Etsy's fees a bit on the pricey side. 📈


Looking for a one-of-a-kind item?[Etsy](https://www.customily.com/etsy) is home to thousands of customizable products, and with **Customily** ,[personalizing them has never been easier .](https://www.customily.com/post/the-best-way-to-sell-personalized-products-on-etsy) Whether it’s a gift or something special for yourself, shop on Etsy and make it truly yours!


## ‍ **Amazon**


Ever thought about selling your own custom items on Amazon? It's like the big daddy of e-commerce, one of the best places to sell unique goods and reach customers all around the world. 🌎


**Features**


What sets Amazon apart? Well, for one, they take trust seriously. With strict seller verification processes and tough measures against counterfeit products, they make it easy for you to build trust with your customers fast. Plus, they offer[Amazon Custom](https://sell.amazon.com/programs/custom) , where shoppers can easily customize products with their own text, images, or logos. Pretty cool, right? ✨


**Pricing**


To sell on Amazon, you'll need a professional selling account, which comes with a monthly fee of[$39.99](https://sell.amazon.com/pricing) . But here's the good part: with the professional plan, you can get prime placement on product detail pages, giving your customized print-on-demand items more visibility. 💼


**Who's it for?**


Amazon is perfect for sellers looking to go global or tap into big markets like the US, Canada, Germany, and more. The professional plan is great for sellers expecting to move a lot of products and want access to advanced selling and advertising tools.


So, it’s a big deal for a starter, but if you're ready to take your business to the next level, Amazon might just be your ticket to success! 🚀


Looking for unique, custom-made products?[Amazon](https://www.customily.com/amazon) is the perfect place to find high-quality, personalized items for every occasion. Thanks to[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) , you can easily[customize a wide range of products and see your design in real time before making a purchase.](https://www.customily.com/post/sell-personalized-products-on-amazon-with-customily)


## ‍ **BigCommerce**


BigCommerce isn't just for the big players. It's a flexible platform for businesses of all sizes. It's designed to grow with you, making it an ideal choice for businesses anticipating expansion 🚀.


But what sets BigCommerce apart from the crowd? While it offers similar features to Shopify or others, it shines in its focus on creating a personalized, multi-storefront experience. With BigCommerce, you can create customized storefronts tailored to different customer segments, giving your business a unique advantage. 💼


‍ **Features**


BigCommerce has a variety of outstanding features, including omni-channel selling capabilities. Seamlessly connect your e-commerce store to multiple marketplaces while keeping inventory management centralized. 🔄


This powerful platform also offers robust customer segmentation based on their background and online shopping habits. Additionally, you can improve the shopping experience with personalized recommendations and promotions. 🎁


**Pricing**


BigCommerce offers[three main pricing plans](https://www.bigcommerce.com/essentials/pricing/) , ranging from $29 to $299 per month, with the Enterprise plan available at a custom price. While there are no transaction fees, keep an eye on the annual sales threshold, starting at $50,000 per year for the Standard plan. 📊


**Who's it for?**


**BigCommerce** caters to businesses of all sizes, but it's particularly well-suited for large-scale enterprises. With advanced eCommerce analytics tools and bulk order management, it's a powerhouse for those aiming for big growth.


Small businesses may find the basic plan's pricing a bit expensive compared to other options on the market. ⚖️


Want a product that’s as unique as you? **BigCommerce** stores powered by[Customily](https://www.customily.com/) let you customize your favorite items with names, images, and designs— **all with a real-time preview** before you buy. Whether you're looking for a thoughtful gift or something special for yourself, **BigCommerce is the perfect place to find high-quality, custom-made products!**


## ‍ **WooCommerce**


WooCommerce is a popular eCommerce platform that operates as an open-source WordPress plugin ⚙. It currently powers over 12% of online stores globally, making it one of the leaders in the eCommerce industry.


With this plugin, you can easily enhance an existing WordPress website with essential online store features. Simply install and activate it, and you can manage your online shop directly from the familiar WordPress dashboard.


**Features**


WooCommerce offers a wide range of features, including inventory management and payment processing. With over hundreds of extensions available, you can enhance its capabilities with store management, shipping options, and marketing tools 🛠.


Regarding design, there are many free themes to choose from in the official WordPress directory. They also have online guides and support forums where experienced professionals and everyday users can offer advice and assistance.


**Pricing**


WooCommerce is free to download and install ♥. However, to use it, you'll need a domain name, hosting service, and a WordPress site. Keep in mind that[WordPress.org](http://wordpress.org/) is the only platform where you can install this plugin for free. If you prefer using[WordPress.com](http://wordpress.com/) , you can access WooCommerce through its Commerce plan, which costs $45 per month.


There are also additional expenses to consider, such as paid customization options like extensions and themes. The WooCommerce Extensions Store offers a wide range of add-ons, from free to premium ones that can cost up to $299 per year.


**Who's it for?**


So, if you already have a website, and you want to add up the possibility of selling products, WooCommerce will undoubtedly be the best option for you ⭐.


It’s one of the most flexible and customizable platforms on the market. That's a good thing! But it also requires more work, beyond the fact that you have different pre-built themes to choose from.


If you are just starting out, it will depend on what your future plans are.


With[WooCommerce and Customily](https://www.customily.com/woocommerce) , customizing products is simple. Add your name, photos, or designs and see exactly how they’ll look before you buy. Whether it’s a gift or something for yourself, shop[WooCommerce and make it truly yours!](https://www.customily.com/post/increasing-your-sales-with-personalized-products-tips-for-woocommerce-sellers)


## ‍ **Shoplazza**


[Shoplazza](https://www.shoplazza.com/) is a global company that offers comprehensive e-commerce technology for merchants. With Shoplazza, individuals of any level of e-commerce expertise can easily create, oversee, and run their own online store from anywhere at any time.


**Features**


The platform is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive. Its drag-and-drop interface simplifies customizing the online store's appearance 🎨, while the step-by-step setup process gently guides users through establishing their store.


Shoplazza provides a robust order management section where you can effortlessly oversee and handle all your orders 📝. Easily access and manage pending orders, update delivery details, and process refunds or cancellations manually for individual orders.


Furthermore, it has an in-house app store offering a variety of integrations with third-party apps and services. This makes it effortless to enhance your online store's functionality with additional features.


**Pricing**


Shoplazza provides access to all its features across its pricing plans, with an additional commission applied to each sale made through the platform. The commission rate decreases 📉 as you move up the plan tiers 📈: starting from the Basic Plan at $28/month with a 2% sales commission, to the Pro Plan at $218/month with a 0.2% sales commission. All plans come with a 7-day free trial and offer the flexibility to upgrade or downgrade at any time during usage.


**Who's it for?**


Shoplazza is ideal for people who lack technical expertise in website development but aspire to establish and grow an online store hassle-free. It handles all aspects, including hosting, site design, security, and payment methods, eliminating the need for a tech team 👩‍💻. If you seek a reliable, fast, and user-friendly platform to kickstart your e-commerce, Shoplazza is a valuable option to explore.


While it may have limitations like limited customization and transaction fees, its numerous benefits far outweigh these drawbacks, making it a compelling choice for aspiring online store owners.


## ‍ **Facebook Marketplace**


Did you know Facebook Marketplace launched in 2016? It's a neat spot for communities to buy and sell custom items online. And the best part? It's totally free! Plus, it's now even more awesome because it supports e-commerce merchants and can integrate with platforms like Shopify. 🛒


**Features**


With Facebook Marketplace, you can list and sell all kinds of stuff – new, preowned, and custom items too! You can create listings, add detailed descriptions, and tap into a huge audience thanks to Facebook's powerful algorithm. Just keep in mind, though, you can't make instant changes to your listings once they're up. 📝


**Pricing**


There are no listing fees on Facebook Marketplace (how cool is that?) It's a super cost-effective way for merchants to sell their goods. Just be sure to follow the community's specific requirements and guidelines. 📋


**Who's it for?**


Facebook Marketplace is perfect for sellers looking to target local communities. With around 80 million registered users, there's a massive pool of potential buyers right at your fingertips. And if you want to amp things up, you can always launch Facebook ad campaigns to reach even more people.


So, if you're all about connecting with your local crowd and making some sales, Facebook Marketplace might just be the place for you! 🎉

### **Frequently Asked Questions About Selling Custom Products Online**


Curious about the best platforms for selling custom products? Check out these frequently asked questions to guide you through the world of print-on-demand personalization and find the perfect website for your needs 🌟


**Which platform is best for beginners looking to offer customized products?**


**‍** If you're just starting out, Shopify is the best choice. Its easy-to-use interface, wide range of print-on-demand apps, and global network make it a fantastic choice for fast, sustainable business growth 🚀


**What are the most popular sites for selling personalized clothing?**


Shopify and Etsy are among the most popular sites for selling personalized clothing. Additionally, Printful, CustomCat, and Printify stand out as top print-on-demand services, offering a wide selection of custom clothing options, intuitive interfaces, and reliable fulfillment services.👕👗


**Where can I sell my custom-made products online for free?**


Looking to sell your custom-made goods without spending a dime? Facebook Marketplace is the perfect platform. With no additional fees, you can create listings and connect with potential customers in your local area hassle-free 💰


**Where can I sell custom products online?**


You can sell custom products on Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Amazon, or Facebook Marketplace. The best choice depends on whether you want marketplace traffic or full brand ownership.


**Can I sell custom products without inventory?**


Yes. With print-on-demand, products are produced and shipped only after a customer orders, so you don’t need to manage inventory.


**Can I sell the same personalized products on more than one platform?**


Yes, and plenty of successful sellers do. The main challenge is operational, not legal; most personalization tools only work on one platform, so switching (or adding) a channel often means rebuilding your customizer from scratch. A cross-platform tool like Customily removes that specific problem, letting your customization setup work the same way everywhere you sell.


**Do I need coding skills to add a product customizer to my store?**


No, on Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, or BigCommerce, apps like Customily install without touching code. WooCommerce can require a bit more technical comfort depending on your existing site setup.
